questions.question: 특정 릴리스에서 완료된 TR 목록은?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release)
                  WHERE r.releaseName = 'Rel-17' AND tr.trStatus = 'Completed'
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle ORDER BY tr.trNumber

questions.question: 현재 진행 중(Living)인 TR 목록은?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)
                  WHERE tr.trStatus = 'Living'
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle

questions.question: 특정 TR이 영향 준 TS 목록은?
특정 TR의 ImpactType은?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.804'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)
                  RETURN imp.impactType, imp.evidenceStatus, count(imp) AS cnt, collect(DISTINCT imp.verifiedImpactScope) AS verifiedScopes
questions.claim_contract: Stored claim inventory: return the declared impact type together with evidenceStatus; pending/rejected records are not established incorporation.

questions.question: NewTS인 TR 목록은?

                  WHERE imp.impactType = 'NewTS'
                  RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, imp.impactType, imp.evidenceStatus, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: 38.825가 어떤 TS에 영향?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.825'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
                  RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: 38.836이 38.300과 38.321에 미친 영향?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.836'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
                  WHERE s.specNumber IN ['38.300', '38.321']
                  RETURN s.specNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription, imp.verifiedImpactScope

questions.question: Rel-17 타겟 TR과 TS 영향 유형?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-17'})
                  OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, collect({spec: s.specNumber, type: imp.impactType, verifiedScope: imp.verifiedImpactScope}) AS impacts

questions.question: 38.835의 결론과 TS 반영?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.835'})
                  OPTIONAL MATCH (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact{evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
                  RETURN tr.conclusions, collect({spec: s.specNumber, type: imp.impactType, verifiedScope: imp.verifiedImpactScope}) AS impacts

questions.question: 특정 TR이 참조하는 다른 TR?
questions.note: RAN2 TR 8개의 References 절이 인용한 TR 중 이 코퍼스에 있는 것이 0건이라 REFERENCES_TR 이 0건이다. 0행이 기대값이므로 allow_zero.
questions.absent_by_design_basis: tr-parser/01_parse_tr_docs.py 의 extract_tr_references 가 TR 8개의 References 절을 모두 찾았고 코퍼스 안 TR 인용은 0건이다(인용한 TR 은 전부 코퍼스 밖). 생산 단계가 있으므로 KG 에 REFERENCES_TR 이 생기면 가드가 이 선언을 결함으로 센다.

questions.question: 가장 많이 참조되는 TR Top N?
questions.cypher:
MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport)
                  RETURN tr.trNumber, count(ref) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10
